name: Art and jewelry appraiser

pf.license.need: No state license for appraising art or jewelry in most places. Where a state or city asks for an appraiser's registration or certificate, or the business's own, the owner names it: shown as given, never checked by Rosie.
pf.license.who holds it: The owner, and each appraiser, as the owner says. Rosie holds no license of anyone.
pf.license.how it's checked: Not checked by Rosie. The owner keeps the papers.
pf.license.insurance or bond: Errors-and-omissions insurance: the owner's own certificate, shown as given, never checked.
pf.license.blocks going live: Nothing: Rosie shows no license claim for any appraiser.
pf.license.renewals: The owner's own list. Rosie sends no reminder for a license it never checked.

pf.services.shape: appraisal visits at the studio (flow A) and at the customer's place (flow B); a video or photo appraisal counts as flow A
pf.services.price kind: one price per item or per collection, from the owner's own list; a travel fee at a home visit is part of the price shown
pf.services.examples: the example studio's own prices (Lee Appraisals, Lee Home Appraisals), not a standard

pf.services.never appraised: No buying, selling or auctions by the appraiser; no appraisal for a sale to the appraiser; no legal or tax advice; no sign-off for a court.
pf.services.capacity: one appraiser per visit; a second person from the team only when the owner books one
pf.services.online: video and photo appraisals only, and only where the owner allows them; Rosie never records a call or a video.

before times: What items: art, jewelry, silver, or a mix? And how many?
Why the appraisal: insurance, an estate, a sale, a donation, or the owner's own record?
Any photos of the items, with the marks, signatures or labels?
At the studio, at the customer's place, or by video?
after a time is picked: Where the items are kept, and the room they'll be shown in
only on the secure page: The street address and any gate code
Who owns the items: the owner's name on the papers, or a family member or trust
Items the customer wants kept private
Where the items are kept (a home safe, a bank box)
pf.questions.who may book: An adult who owns the items, or who has the owner's written permission. An appraisal of items the booker doesn't own needs that owner's yes.

words that stop a booking: someone hurt, or a fire or smoke at the place (call 911)
words that go on with safety steps: an item that may be stolen or isn't the booker's to show

what Rosie says.stolen item: The appraiser asks for the papers and may decline. Rosie doesn't judge the item.

pf.safety.legal questions: Never answered: an appraiser can't give legal or tax advice.

prep for the reminder: Bring the papers, receipts and any earlier appraisals
Have the items clean and dry; don't tape or glue anything
Photos of marks, signatures and labels
A flat table with good light for the items

pf.visit.check-in: At the studio: the code at the front desk. At a home: the code from whoever meets the appraiser.
pf.visit.before appraising: The appraiser checks each item's marks and papers in person, then writes a report for the owner. Nothing is valued in a text.
pf.visit.work changes: A second item found at the visit is priced at the list price and OK'd by the owner before it's done.
pf.visit.stops: An item looks stolen, or the owner has no right to it: the appraiser stops and says so.
pf.visit.report: The written report goes to the owner on the secure page, with the value stated once.

pf.money.before: a card saved for the late-cancel fee at the studio; paid in full for video and single-item visits; a deposit for estate collections
pf.money.after: paid at the desk, the bill texted after a home visit, or the saved card charged at DONE
pf.money.cancel: a cancel in time gets a full refund; a late cancel or no-show keeps the fee shown on the booking
pf.money.caps: the owner's own limit: any quote over $500 is OK'd by the owner first

plugin.pf.messages: Texts go to the owner who booked. Item values and descriptions are never in a text: the secure page only.

pf.staff.licenses: none from the state; the owner's own certificates, shown as given
pf.staff.standIn: any trained appraiser; nobody is booked by name
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs quotes over $500 and any value dispute

pf.rules.no sales: Rosie never sells anything for the appraiser. No buying, no auctions, no consignment.
pf.rules.values: A value is in the written report only, never in a text or on a screen shared with others.
pf.rules.limits: Items over the insurer's limit need the owner's yes first.

pf.edges.walkins: A walk-in takes a visit when there's a free slot; else the next free day.
pf.edges.photos: A photo appraisal needs clear photos of every mark first; without them the appraiser asks for more.

story.A: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex M. books Lee Appraisals for one painting, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, for an insurance report. Vera checks the painting at the studio, and Alex pays $35 at the front desk.
story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex M. books Lee Home Appraisals to look at 5 items at home, 14 Cedar Ln. Tomas comes Thu Oct 22 between 8 and 10am, looks at each item and writes the report. The $179 is charged to Alex's saved card, or the bill comes after the visit.

A.staff: Vera and Ines (appraiser and front desk)

B.other: Others (a bank, a trust, a family)

notes: Art and jewelry appraiser (from notary: an appointment for papers and items, checked in person; flow B a home visit). Refit for the rebuilt master (N4, Oct 27). Flow A (Lee Appraisals, the studio): a one-item studio appraisal, $35, a card saved for the $20 fee, paid at the desk; a video appraisal of one item, $55, paid in full; an estate collection at the studio, $140 ($40 deposit, $100 rest at the desk); a collection quoted from photos, $90 ($20 deposit once OK'd, $70 rest billed with the report); a free quote from photos. Flow B (Lee Home Appraisals, the appraiser comes to the customer): a home appraisal of up to 5 items, $179 with the $89 travel fee (card saved, bill after); an estate collection at home, $150 ($40 deposit, $110 rest at DONE); one item at a home, $75 paid in full. Items are never sold, bought or kept; values are in the written report only. Licenses, insurance and certificates are the owner's, shown as given, never checked (D96). Child visits are off (A4-24). $2 applies to every booking (D97). Sensitive is off. Gap: a damaged item during a visit (work/gaps/art-appraiser.json).
